Every entry in this file comes from web-search result summaries of the cited URLs. URLs are real search results, but page wording, numbers and dates should be spot-checked on the live page before external use.

Product-page dates: Sprinklr product and customer-story pages carry no visible publication date in search results, so they are marked 'undated'. Several product pages appear to be 2-3+ years old by search metadata and may use older wording.

Exact current module list for Sprinklr Service: the sprinklr.com/products menu ('4 suites and 33 products') and the FY2026 10-K business section could not be read in full, so the capability names here are taken from individual product pages, help articles, release notes and press releases. 'Service Command Center' is named as a Sprinklr Service product in the FY2026 10-K but no description was retrieved, so it is not listed as a capability.

Unified customer profile: no Sprinklr page explicitly describing a 'unified customer profile' product was found; only 'common data foundation' / 'unified view of customer interactions' wording on the Unified-CXM platform.

AI governance page attribution: the guardrails / approval workflows / usage logs / zero-data-retention wording was returned for Sprinklr's AI+ pages, but it is not confirmed whether it sits on /products/platform/ai-plus or /products/platform/ai-plus-studio.

BYOM/BYOK constraints reported in help docs (customer hosts the model; Sprinklr AI and BYOM/BYOK cannot be combined in one deployment; no dynamic runtime model switching) - check against current contract terms before quoting.
Agent Assist vs Agent Copilot: both product pages exist; whether 'Agent Assist' is still sold as a separate module or has been folded into Agent Copilot was not confirmed.

Voice AI stack naming: help articles name the voice options inconsistently (Sprinklr Speech Engine / Sprinklr Orchestrated ElevenLabs / Legacy / Native). Do not quote engine names to prospects without checking the current UI.

Forrester TEI of Sprinklr Service: whether the '2024' study is a new study or a re-labelled 2021 'Sprinklr Modern Care' study. Both report 210% ROI and payback under six months, but supporting figures differ (2024 page: legacy cost reduction $799k, training $78k; 2021 press release: nearly $336,000 licence savings, about $27,300 training savings, $2.1M from fewer social care interactions).
Forrester TEI '$3.28 million total benefits over three years' - appeared in one search summary of a Sprinklr page but could not be confirmed in a second targeted search.
Gartner Magic Quadrant for CCaaS 2023 and 2024: whether Sprinklr was included, and in which quadrant, could not be confirmed. Only its absence from the 2025 and 2026 editions is supported.
Gartner Magic Quadrant for Conversational AI Platforms 2026: Niche Player placement rests on CX Today's summary; exact publication date unclear (sources differ).
